newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kyushu Oil to bid in Kyushu Electric power tender.
newsitem.headline: Kyushu Oil to bid in Kyushu Electric power tender.

text.p: Kyushu Oil Co Ltd said on Monday it plans to bid in Kyushu Electric Power Co Inc's term tender to buy electricity from independent power producers (IPPs) for 15 years starting in either 2001 or 2002.
"We are almost set to participate in the tender," a Kyushu Oil spokesman said.

Kyushu Electric, a regional power utility serving Japan's southern island of Kyushu, last week floated a tender to buy 300,000 kilowatts (kw) of electricity for the 15-year period. The tender will close in September.

Kyushu Oil was awarded a sale of 137,000 kw of electricity to Kyushu Electric for 15 years from 1999 in a tender last year, and plans to start construction this summer of a 25-billion-yen power plant that runs on residue oil at its 136,000 barrel-per-day Oita refinery on Kyushu island.
The oil firm will build another facility with similar capacity if it wins this year's tender, the spokesman said.
